# Forcli AI Marketplace

Curated plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and other MCP-compatible tools.

## Install (Claude Code)

```bash
/plugin marketplace add forcli/forcli-ai-marketplace
```

## Available Plugins

| Plugin | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `teams-reader` | Read Microsoft Teams conversations via browser automation |

### Install a plugin

```bash
/plugin install teams-reader@forcli-ai-marketplace
```

## MCP Server (Universal)

All plugins also work as standalone MCP servers for Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Cursor, etc.

See each plugin's README for MCP configuration.

plugins.description: Read Microsoft Teams conversations via Playwright browser automation. Supports Azure AD SSO with persistent login.
